name: Iluka Retreat & Camp
signature: Thirty structures on 36 acres near Shoreham — the Peninsula's only fixed-site multi-tent group glamping venue with a private freshwater lake
editorNote:
Iluka is the Peninsula's group glamping venue. A bell-tent village plus two group lodges on 36 acres near Shoreham, with a private freshwater lake, bird hides, a challenge course, and canoe and SUP hire. Capacity to 100 guests across 30 structures. Shared camp bathrooms and a shared kitchen.

This is not a couples-escape product. The rate-per-head calculation changes depending on how many structures you book, and the appeal runs through the group dynamic — yoga weekends, work retreats, social weekends, hens parties. For individual glamping, Peninsula Hot Springs is the right address. For a group that wants to own an outdoor venue for two nights, Iluka is the most capable product on the Peninsula.
whyWeGo: The Peninsula's only fixed-site glamping venue with capacity for groups up to 100 — the answer for retreats and social weekends that need outdoor infrastructure.
ifOnlyOneThing: Confirm whether you need the full site or just the bell-tent section — capacity and pricing are both much more flexible than the website implies.
